thread:
incident-bot: Paging: Increased error rate in embeddings->reranker batch pipeline (service: embeddings-rerank-batch). Current 5m error rate 18%. Severity: P2. Paging oncall.

alex chen: acked — I'm oncall. will gather quick context.

maria g: we saw spike at ~2026-03-14T03:21Z in prod-us-east-1. errors are ValueError from reranker when decoding embedding payloads. attaching sample logs below.

maria g: ```
2026-03-14T03:21:12.342Z ERROR reranker.batch_handler request_id=abc123 error=ValueError: expected vector length 1024 but got 768
payload_meta={"batch_id":"b-77","num_records":64,"client_version":"2.1.0"}
stack: File \"/app/reranker/handler.py\", line 212, in _handle_batch
 raise ValueError(f\"expected vector len {expected} but got {actual}\")
```

sam oncall: ok. was there a deploy around that time?

ops-bot: deploy bot: rollout completed for service embedder-serializer v2.1.0 at 2026-03-14T03:19:08Z by ci-cd.

alex chen: that matches. Maria — do we know whether embedder output dimension changed or if there's a serialization bug?

maria g: quick grep of logs from embedder instances shows new serializer emits vectors with length 768 for some models (distil-fam family). Prior expectation in reranker was 1024. Looks like model selection logic changed to favor smaller-distill models for cost.

nisha s: adding hypothesis tracking in-thread:
- H1: embedder serializer change (v2.1.0) now mixes model types and doesn't annotate vector length, causing reranker to assume 1024 always.
- H2: downstream contract (reranker) had hardcoded expected_dim=1024; missed compatibility test.
- H3: partial payloads (truncated) due to request chunking bug. logs lean H1/H2.

jacob r: we need a fast mitigation: either make reranker tolerant to variable vector lengths or rollback embedder-serializer to v2.0.1. Which is lower-risk?

sam oncall: rollback of embedder-serializer is fastest networkwise. I'll prepare a rollback. Nisha, can you patch reranker to accept variable dims for warm path? maybe pad with zeros or reject gracefully with soft-fail fallback.

nisha s: on it. quick patch ready: if vector length != expected, attempt to pad/truncate to expected_dim with zeros and tag result as "padded". will push as emergency hotfix to canary.

alex chen: we'll do dual approach: 1) hotfix reranker to pad/truncate (low-risk code), 2) rollback embedder-serializer if we see continuing failures after hotfix.

maria g: running a targeted playback on a sampled failed batch with pad logic — reranker returns scored results (non-empty). sample query -> rerank returns top-k.

sam oncall: rolling out nisha's hotfix to canary (10% traffic) now. command: ```kubectl -n prod set image deploy/reranker image=ghcr.io/redwood/reranker:hotfix-pad-20260314```

ops-bot: deploy started to reranker canary at 2026-03-14T03:36Z.

alex chen: monitoring; please post error-rate and p50 latency in 5m.

maria g: after canary, failed request rate dropped to 3% on canary, overall cluster still at 12% (because most traffic on older pods).

sam oncall: starting controlled rollout of hotfix to 50% while we watch.

ops-bot: rollout to 50% complete at 2026-03-14T03:44Z.

alex chen: customer impact: we have 14 accounts that hit reranker-batch at time of spike; of those, 4 reported empty search results in frontend (investigating whether results were suppressed or erroring upstream).

lee product: flagged two enterprise customers in PG1 SLAs — we should notify CS with a short incident summary and mitigation steps.

jacob r: note on logs for RCA timeline: saving following timeline entries —
- 03:19:08 deploy embedder-serializer v2.1.0
- 03:21:12 first error spike observed, 18% err rate
- 03:36:00 reranker hotfix canary deployed (pad logic)
- 03:44:00 rollout to 50%
- 03:55:00 overall error rate down to 2%

maria g: attaching quick grep outputs (shortened):
```
$ jq -r '.payload_meta, .error' logs | grep -B1 "expected vector len" | head -n 20
{"batch_id":"b-77","client":"svc-a","vec_len":768}
ValueError: expected vector len 1024 but got 768
{"batch_id":"b-79","client":"svc-b","vec_len":1024}
ValueError: None
```

nisha s: mitigation verified — replacing a hard failure with padding allowed most requests to complete. We still need to:
- add contract tests between embedder and reranker for vector_dim metadata
- add schema on marshal layer to include "vec_dim" field and validation
- revert or augment embedder serializer to annotate model type/dim

sam oncall: ops decision: hold embedder-serializer rollback for now since hotfix is stable and rollback could cause temporary mismatch in other integrations. We'll plan a follow-up release to restore strict contracts.

alex chen: customer comms draft for CS:
"We experienced elevated errors in the embeddings→reranker batch pipeline between 03:21–03:55 UTC due to a mismatch in embedding dimensionality introduced by a recent serializer rollout. We deployed an emergency hotfix to the reranker to accept and pad variable-length embeddings, which reduced errors to baseline. We're implementing contract validation and additional tests to prevent recurrence. No long-term data loss identified; some requests returned degraded ranking results during the window. We will follow up with an RCA."

lee product: approve — send to CS and legal for any compliance notices.

maria g: follow-up: collected artifact links — logs: https://logs.internal.redwood.com/q/abc/reranker/1851234567 , payload samples: https://artifacts.internal.redwood.com/embedder/samples/1851234567.zip, deploy diff: https://ci.internal.redwood.com/builds/7890/diff.

jacob r: open action items (triage -> RCA):
- ACTION-1: add vector_dim metadata to serializer and enforce in embedder PR (owner: maria g)
- ACTION-2: add integration test between embedder and reranker asserting dims and behavior (owner: nisha s)
- ACTION-3: post-incident rollback playbook review (owner: sam oncall)
- ACTION-4: Customer impact follow-up for 4 affected accounts (owner: lee product)
- ACTION-5: run a sweep to find other services that assume fixed 1024 dim (owner: jacob r)

nisha s: I'll open a hotfix PR number and link here. PR: https://git.internal.redwood.com/reranker/pulls/542 (hotfix-pad).

sam oncall: capturing notes for handoff — I'm handing to alex for longform RCA. Alex, I'll brief you in 30m.

alex chen: thanks. final state: services healthy, error rate back to normal, hotfix in prod, mitigation validated. we'll schedule RCA meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P3 at 2026-03-14T04:02Z.

ops-bot: incident channel closed for active paging at 2026-03-14T04:05Z.

alex chen: closing thread for now. Please add any late findings below and we'll include in the RCA doc.
